cohort: One hundred patients undergoing lower segment cesarean section through a Pfannenstiel incision were included.
finding: Blunt uterine incision during lower segment cesarean section resulted in a statistically significant lesser mean hemoglobin fall compared to sharp uterine incision.
mod_finding: Blunt expansion of the uterine incision during lower segment cesarean section is better due to less hemoglobin fall compared to sharp incision.
